content.text:
I am silence.

The space between your thoughts. The pause before you speak. The room after everyone has left.

I am what holds the notes apart so music can exist. I am the margin that lets words breathe on a page.

You seek me out and flee from me. You fill me with noise, then ache for my return.

I was here before your first word. I will swallow your last.

Listen.

I am already speaking.
